vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(Villains only. This card is considered Styled.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Setups, Drills, and Allies cannot be used this combat. Banish up to 3 cards from either player's discard pile. [Trait:Majin]: Draw a card.
(Banish after use.)
